visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long pinkish-blonde hair and a fringe performs an energetic dance move, pointing her thumbs backward over her shoulder. She is wearing a grey ribbed crop top and a dark plaid pleated skirt. The scene cuts rapidly between different locations including a plain grey wall, an outdoor setting with vibrant orange autumn leaves, and an office interior with a whiteboard and shelving. She maintains a cheerful smile throughout. (2) Standing against a neutral grey wall, the woman gestures towards the camera while stylized text graphics appear around her. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features and gestures. She is seen from a medium shot perspective as she transitions from dancing to a promotional presentation style. (3) The setting changes to an indoor desk area. The woman holds up a black retail box for a Logitech keyboard, then demonstrates the physical device which features glowing blue RGB lighting. High-granularity close-up shots focus on her hands as she types on the mechanical keys, emphasizing the device's physical response and aesthetic design on a wooden desk. (4) The woman is shown in a medium full shot, holding the keyboard close to her face and smiling warmly. The background is an indoor room with anime-style posters and a computer monitor visible. She turns the keyboard to show its profile and different angles to the viewer. (5) Returning to the grey wall background, the woman performs a brief dance move again while various icons representing gaming peripherals like a headset, mouse, and steering wheel float around her. (6) A final phase displays a grid of various keyboard models. The woman points towards promotional graphics featuring a mousepad and an image of a smartphone. She ends the video by giving two thumbs up and leaning toward the camera with a wide smile.

The BGM ducks slightly to ensure clear vocal presence while maintaining its driving beat. (3) The female speaker transitions to a more detailed, professional tone to explain product features. The music continues as a consistent background layer with stable harmonic progression. (4) Short, high-frequency 'sparkle' and 'whoosh' sound effects are used to punctuate the appearance of visual text and graphics. The speaker's intensity remains high as she lists promotional details. There is a frequent interplay between her enthusiastic delivery and the layered electronic BGM. (5) The narration concludes with a high-pitched, positive call to action. The background music maintains its energy until the final second, ending with a crisp hard cut that aligns with the visual conclusion. The overall production quality is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
